scope: Open-source research part 3 for Fuobe: the open ComfyUI route for the round-3 features (Layers, Moodboards, Soul HEX, Shorts Studio, Mixed Media, sound effects, dubbing, captions, product 3D/try-on, Cinema Studio grid and Soul Cast, Faceless). Companion to comfyui-oss.json (rankings), comfyui-oss-2.json (round 2) and workflows/comfyui/manifest.json (library).

conventions.graph: ComfyUI API format (POST /prompt body.prompt). Links are [nodeId, outputSlot]. Placeholder file names in LoadImage/LoadAudio/LoadVideo/VHS_LoadVideo are replaced by uploads. Node ids like "83:37" are subgraph-instance ids kept from the official template export.
conventions.bindings: canonical key -> list of {node, input} (same shape as workflows/comfyui/manifest.json). All targets are literal inputs, never links (checked by the builder). Keys beyond src/lib/comfy.ts BindingKey are passed through ProviderInput.extra; new ones this round: layers, resolution, paletteText, method, strength, start, duration (seconds), startFrame, controlStrength, framesPerBatch, checkpoint, description, instruction, text, maxTokens, language, asrModel, hints, maxChars, audio2, backgroundVolumeDb, startStep, audioScale, lengthMode, lipsExpression, whisperModel, fontSize, fontColor, textureSize, turntableFps, octreeResolution, columns, rows, gridPrompt, sheetPrompt, image4.
conventions.outputs: kind image | video | audio | text | 3d. New kinds: "text" (SaveText ui = {text:[...], files:[{filename,subfolder,type}]}, a .txt in output/) and "3d" (Save3DAdvanced ui = {"3d":[{filename,subfolder,type}], camera_info, model_3d_info}, a .glb). Fuobe collectFiles already walks every ui array of {filename,subfolder,type}; it needs MediaKind "text"/"3d" and guessKind for .txt/.glb. PreviewAny reports strings under ui.text (no file). VHS_VideoCombine reports under .gifs[].
conventions.nodes: class_type input specs dumped from the live /object_info of the validation server(s), so names/types/defaults/options are exactly what the server accepts. Long option lists are truncated.
conventions.models.sizeGB: decimal GB from the Hugging Face tree API (2026-10-17); null = not resolvable. folder "custom (...)" = node-managed auto-download location.
conventions.validation.postPrompt: true = POST /prompt accepted with HTTP 200, a prompt_id and no node_errors (CPU, zero-byte placeholder weights, never executed; deleted from the queue behind a KJNodes Sleep blocker). server "main" = /home/user/ComfyUI on :8188; "isolated" = a second ComfyUI (same commit and venv, its own base directory and HOME) on :8189 for packs with global side effects.
conventions.verified: true = every graph of the recommended route passed live /prompt validation and the remaining semantics are documented; false = the route depends on inferred behaviour (listed in inferred) or on a chain not yet run with weights.
conventions.realRun: graphs without model weights that were actually executed on the CPU ComfyUI, with ffprobe-checked outputs.

capabilities.title: Image layer decomposition (Layers: split into editable RGBA layers, "Separate layer")
capabilities.higgsfield: Layers studio: decompose an image into named, positioned layers; edit each, "Separate layer" recursively, export a zip of cropped/positioned layers
capabilities.summary: Qwen-Image-Layered (Apache-2.0) is native in ComfyUI 0.41 (EmptyQwenImageLayeredLatentImage + ReferenceLatent + LatentCut/LatentCutToBatch, official template image_qwen_image_layered). It returns full-canvas RGBA layers; the app computes each layer's bbox from alpha for the cropped/positioned export. The prompt-guided DiffSynth Layered-Control variant pulls out a named element (click/describe to separate).

recommended.name: Layer decomposition: Qwen-Image-Layered (RGBA layers)

outputs.note: batch of `layers` full-canvas RGBA PNGs, back to front (the composite latent slice 0 is cut off by LatentCut index 1)

recommended.notes: Template image_qwen_image_layered (2025-12-22) with the fp8mixed weights instead of bf16. The input is scaled so its longest side = resolution (640 is the trained bucket; 1024 works, slower). layers = how many RGBA layers come out (1-10 is sensible; the latent holds layers+1 slices and slice 0, the reconstructed composite, is cut off). prompt = optional caption of the whole image (the template uses a full description; empty works). VAEDecode with the 4-channel layered VAE yields RGBA, SaveImage writes RGBA PNGs. Each layer is a full-canvas RGBA image: compute its bounding box from alpha in the browser for the cropped/positioned layer export. Recursive "Separate layer" = run again on one layer.
inferred: quality/VRAM at 1024 px with fp8mixed (template note recommends 640 px)

capabilities.title: Moodboards: generate in the style of 4-20 reference images
capabilities.higgsfield: Moodboards: upload 5-80 images, "Building your moodboard...", then generate with that style (personal style id on Soul 2.0)
capabilities.summary: Two tiers. Instant (zero-shot): the app turns the board into 1-2 contact-sheet collages and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 + Lightning generates a NEW image (empty latent) conditioned on them with a "match the look, not the content" instruction (Apache, weights already in the library). Persistent (1:1 with Higgsfield, which trains moodboards): an AI-Toolkit style LoRA on Z-Image Turbo from the 5-80 images (same training path as characters, style preset below), then z-image-turbo-t2i + LoRA. Purpose-built style-reference models exist but are licence-gated: Krea-2 + Ostris style_reference LoRA (Krea 2 Community) and USO on FLUX.1 dev (non-commercial base).

recommended.name: Moodboard style reference: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 + Lightning, new image from 2 board collages
recommended.officialTemplate: image_qwen_image_edit_2511 (material replacement) re-targeted: empty latent output + references as style

inputs.string_b: a portrait of a woman in a sunlit kitchen
. Render it in the exact visual style of the reference moodboard images: same colour palette, lighting, contrast, grain, lens look, texture and mood. Do not copy their subjects, layout or text.

recommended.notes: The app builds 1-2 collages from the board (e.g. 4-20 images as a 3x3/4x4 contact sheet each, ~1 MP) and uploads them as image / image2; the instruction tells the model to borrow the look, not the content. Output size is the empty latent (any aspect ratio). Lightning 4-step at cfg 1 (set loraStrength 0, steps 40, cfg 4 for the slow full-quality path). Zero-shot preview; for a persistent moodboard train a style LoRA (style-lora-zimage-turbo).
inferred: style-only transfer from a collage (vs content leakage) is not measured; Qwen-Image-Edit is trained for edits, so a GPU check of how much board content leaks is needed

capabilities.title: Soul HEX colour signatures: palette-conditioned generation
capabilities.higgsfield: Soul HEX: pick or extract a 1-12 colour signature (+ background), generate in those colours; Cinema Studio colour palettes
capabilities.summary: No maintained palette ControlNet exists for current open models (the colour T2I-Adapter is SD1.5-era). Best route: put the hex list in the prompt and lock it deterministically with core ColorTransfer against a swatch the app renders, in ONE job (palette-zimage-hex on Z-Image Turbo, Apache). The existing palette-transfer-image/-video graphs do the lock as a post-step for any model (cloud outputs too).

capabilities.title: Shorts Studio: restyle your own footage with a preset (<=2 min in, segments out)
capabilities.higgsfield: Shorts Studio: pick one of 44 presets (or a custom preset from up to 10 reference images/videos), upload 4 s-2 min footage, get restyled 9:16/16:9 720p segments (<=10 s each), stitch or download parts
capabilities.summary: Chained open route: (1) video-segment-resample cuts <=5 s windows at 16 fps and saves each first frame; (2) qwen-image-edit-2511 (or -multi with the custom-preset references) restyles that frame with the preset prompt; (3) video-restyle-wan22-fun-vace re-renders the segment with Wan 2.2 Fun VACE: frame 0 = restyled frame (kept), frames 1..N = Depth Anything 3 depth maps (generated), restyled frame also as VACE reference; (4) video-concat-N joins the segments. Grade-type presets (Warm Glow, Monochrome Vibes, Green Contrast...) are cheaper with video-relight-bernini-r (prompt-driven video edit) or palette-transfer-video, caption presets add the captions route.

recommended.notes: Chained route for Shorts Studio: video-segment-resample (<=81 frames @16 fps + first frame) -> qwen-image-edit-2511 restyles the first frame with the preset prompt (and the custom preset references as image2/3) -> this graph -> video-concat-N joins the segments and the original audio rides along per segment (CreateVideo takes the segment audio). Control: frame 0 = the restyled frame with mask 0 (keep), frames 1..N-1 = DA3 depth maps with mask 1 (generate), and the restyled frame is also the VACE reference_image, so the look is anchored on both. Swap DA3 for Canny (core) to keep more structure (logos, text). frames must be 4n+1 and <= the segment length.

Zero-shot fallback with no new weights: qwen-image-edit-2511-multi ("dress the person in image 1 in the garments of images 2 and 3"). Product shots/ads reuse qwen-image-edit-2511-multi (product + scene/reference ad), relight-qwen-edit-2509(-reference) and bg-remove-birefnet.

recommended.name: Virtual try-on: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B + try-on LoRA, person (clothes masked out) + top + bottom (all Apache)

inputs.text: TRYON a full-body photo of a person. Replace the outfit with the top and bottom as shown in the reference images. The final image is a full body shot.

recommended.license: Apache-2.0 (FLUX.2 klein 4B, try-on LoRA by xocialize); segformer_b2_clothes MIT; ComfyUI-RMBG code GPL-3.0
recommended.notes: Reference order is load-bearing (LoRA card): person, top, bottom; for a dress pass it as both. The LoRA was trained on clothing-agnostic inputs, so ClothesSegment (upper clothes, skirt, dress, pants, belt, scarf; offset 8 px) greys the old outfit out (ImageCompositeMasked with a mid-grey EmptyImage, resized). Trigger word TRYON. Output size = the person image (~1 MP).
inferred: the LoRA (trained on klein base 4B) on the 4-step distilled checkpoint; switch to the base checkpoint (20 steps, cfg 5) if results are weak

capabilities.title: Cinema Studio image grid / contact sheet (2x2, 3x3, 4x4; freeform, zooms, shots)
capabilities.higgsfield: Cinema Studio grid generation: one prompt -> a full grid sharing the same context, same cost as one image; sizes 2x2/3x3/4x4; types freeform, zooms, shots, next_shots, prev_shots
capabilities.summary: One Z-Image Turbo generation of an N x N contact sheet, then KJNodes ImageGridtoBatch cuts it into tiles (both the sheet and the tiles are saved). next_shots / prev_shots continue from a chosen tile with the library storyboard-qwen-edit-2509-next-scene.

recommended.name: Cinema Studio image grid: one Z-Image Turbo contact sheet (2x2 / 3x3 / 4x4) + the tiles cut out

inputs.string_a: A 3x3 grid contact sheet of nine film stills from the same scene, edge to edge with thin black gutters, consistent characters, wardrobe, lighting and colour grade in every panel, varied shot sizes and angles:
inputs.string_b: a detective in a rain-soaked neon alley at night

recommended.notes: Matches Higgsfield's "full grid from a single prompt, every image shares the same context": one generation, then the sheet is cut into equal tiles (ImageGridtoBatch, max 8x8). gridPrompt is chosen by the app per size/type: freeform, zooms ("the same frame at 9 increasing zoom levels"), shots ("nine different shot sizes of the same moment"), next_shots / prev_shots (use storyboard-qwen-edit-2509-next-scene from a picked tile instead). Width/height: 2048x2048 for square tiles; 2048x1152 makes 16:9 tiles in a 3x3 grid only if the model keeps equal cells, so the app should crop each tile to the requested ratio. Gutters: keep them thin; the app can trim a few px per tile.
inferred: how reliably Z-Image Turbo draws an exact NxN grid with equal cells (Qwen-Image 2512 is the stronger layout follower if it drifts)

capabilities.title: Faceless Studio / Explainer: script -> scenes -> narrated, captioned video
capabilities.higgsfield: Faceless / Explainer studio: script or topic -> scene list -> visuals per scene -> voice-over -> captions -> one video
capabilities.summary: No new model: a chain of validated graphs. Script and scene split by Fuobe's LLM; per scene z-image-turbo-t2i (or a storyboard) -> wan22-i2v-14b-lightx2v (or Ken Burns in the browser); narration tts-chatterbox-multilingual; captions-qwen3-asr on the narration (exact timings) -> ASS burn-in; video-concat-N joins scenes; video-mux-audio adds narration + music bed (music-ace-step-15).

recommended.name: Chained Faceless pipeline on existing + round-3 graphs
recommended.notes: Scene length = narration length of that scene (TTS per scene first, then frames = duration*16+1 for Wan). Captions are burned last so they sit above transitions.

risks: Long chains: a failed step fails its dependants (existing chained-jobs behaviour)
